lines.zh: 我在沉船四周巡，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle the wreck, lap after lap.

lines.zh: 骨头在水里划，没什么声音。
lines.en: My bones slice the water almost silently.

lines.zh: 船板裂了，我从缝里穿过去。
lines.en: The hull is split; I slip through the gap.
These waters are dark; perfect cover.

lines.zh: 我用头骨开路，水草全断。
lines.en: My skull leads, cutting every weed.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，就窜出去老远。
lines.en: One flick of my tail carries me far.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床走，沙子翻起来。
lines.en: I skim the seabed, kicking up sand.

lines.zh: 沉船的箱子还开着，里面空的。
lines.en: The wreck's chest lies open and empty.
A dolphin passes; I follow it.

lines.zh: 我绕着桅杆转，像在守什么。
lines.en: I circle the mast as if guarding it.

lines.zh: 水流变了，有东西在靠近。
lines.en: The current shifts; something approaches.

lines.zh: 骨头碰着石头，发出闷响。
lines.en: Bone knocks on stone with a dull knock.

lines.zh: 从破洞钻出来，外面更黑。
lines.en: I slip out the breach; it is darker outside.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，鱼都散开。
lines.en: Where I pass, the fish scatter.

lines.zh: 我在破渔网间穿行，骨头挂着线。
lines.en: I weave through torn nets, bones catching thread.

lines.zh: 沉船的龙骨断了，我从中间过去。
lines.en: The keel is snapped; I pass through the gap.

lines.zh: 我闻到沉船那头的咸味。
lines.en: I smell salt from beyond the wreck.
Don't kick up sand from my wreck's floor.

lines.zh: 我这颗尖头骨，能刺也能砍。
lines.en: This pointed skull of mine can stab and slash.

lines.zh: 沉船的木板，我一根根数过。
lines.en: I have counted every plank of this wreck.
I'm swimming somewhere darker.

lines.zh: 这条水道我游了上百年。
lines.en: I've swum this channel a hundred years.

lines.zh: 沉船的桅杆我又看见了。
lines.en: There's the wreck's mast again.
Keep to my bony tail. Don't scatter.

lines.zh: 沉船边上，我的骨头在响。
lines.en: By the wreck, my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 沉船周围的暗水，是我的猎场。
lines.en: The dark water round the wreck is my hunting ground.
By the wreck, I cut the water with my skull.
I rest only after this black water.

lines.zh: 沉船旁边，我的头骨先探出去。
lines.en: By the wreck, my skull goes first.
Into the wreck's depths I swim slowly.
Who's stirring silt by my wreck?
My skull saws back and forth.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，骨头轻轻晃。
lines.en: I hang in the water, bones swaying gently.

lines.zh: 头骨还在我前面，冷冷地对着。
lines.en: My skull juts ahead, cold and pointed.
It is too quiet here; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 有几条小鱼在我肋下游。
lines.en: Small fish swim between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我看不见远处，只听见水声。
lines.en: I cannot see far, only hear the water.

lines.zh: 沉船的影子在水底拖得很长。
lines.en: The wreck's shadow drags long on the floor.

lines.zh: 我张了张颚，没有声音出来。
lines.en: I open my jaw; no sound comes out.

lines.zh: 海草缠上尾骨，我甩掉了。
lines.en: Seaweed catches my tail bone; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 背上的骑手不在了，空落落。
lines.en: My rider is gone; my back feels bare.
My bones rattle against each other.

lines.zh: 我在等水流把味道带过来。
lines.en: I wait for the current to bring a scent.
No light in the wreck. Good.
I have guarded this wreck a long while.
One movement, one click of bone.

lines.zh: 沉船边，我数到第几尾了。
lines.en: By the wreck, how many fish have I counted?
The school hasn't passed my wreck yet.

lines.zh: 我看这片珊瑚骨架真高。
lines.en: These coral skeletons stand so tall to me.

lines.zh: 我看船板缝漏下一线光。
lines.en: I watch a thread of light leak through the planks.
Black water nudges me; I just sway.
My bones soak in the water. Cold.
I patrol the sunken wrecks.

lines.zh: 又一条船影从我头顶过。
lines.en: Another hull's shadow passes over me.

lines.zh: 我骨头上有点幽幽的亮。
lines.en: A faint glow clings to my bones.

lines.zh: 船底的苔藓蹭着我骨头。
lines.en: Moss on the hull brushes my bones.
Skull for a sword, I stab through the water.

lines.zh: 我挂在船板上漂着也行。
lines.en: Hanging on a plank and drifting suits me.

lines.zh: 沉船边的水，我一层层巡。
lines.en: By the wreck I patrol layer by layer.

lines.zh: 沉船里到底有多少骨头？
lines.en: How many bones are in this wreck?
You carry the warmth of the living.
Do not come in; the water is mine.
Your boots creak on the ship's planks.
My eyes rest on your throat.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑，跟我头骨像。
lines.en: That sword in your hand resembles my skull.
Back away; I count to three.

lines.zh: 海豚在哪？你跟它们一伙？
lines.en: Where are the dolphins? Are you with them?
You have stood by the wreck too long.
Bone remembers the smell of the living.
I do not blink, for I have no eyes.
My skull can saw back and forth.
First time I've seen a two-legged fish.
I use my skull as a blade and cut sideways.

lines.zh: 我看你腰上挂着铁钩子。
lines.en: I see an iron hook at your belt.
Skelewag? I'll remember that.
I know the sand on your feet.

lines.zh: 我看你的气泡一串串往上。
lines.en: I watch your bubbles rise in strings.

lines.zh: 我该躲船底，还是盯着你？
lines.en: Hide under the hull, or keep watching you?

lines.zh: 沉船边巡逻，我全身是骨头。
lines.en: Patrolling by the wreck, all bone.
I see no gills, no scales on you.
Who touched my bones?
You call that a wound?
I turn, my skull pointed at you.
Half a bone broke; it hardly matters.
I do not retreat; I only get fiercer.
The water fills with the sound of bones.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，却打不沉我。
lines.en: You can hit me, but you cannot sink me.
I will keep this blow in my bones.
One swing of my tail and I steady.
I press to the hull and let it shield me.

lines.zh: 骨头散了一地，我自己捡回来。
lines.en: My bones scattered; I gathered them myself.
I need to slip back into the wreck's dark hold.
Don't knock it. My bone plates are thin.

lines.zh: 头骨还完整，能再切一次。
lines.en: My skull is whole. It can cut again.
I hadn't turned my skull yet.
A hook scraped off one of my ribs.
You snapped my bony fin.
One more knock and my bone will crack.

lines.zh: 我身上只剩骨头，可还没散。
lines.en: Only bones left, and still together.
I need to reach the surface for a breath.

lines.zh: 水花一动，我就想冲过去。
lines.en: When the water stirs, I want to charge.

lines.zh: 有东西在扑腾，我听见了。
lines.en: Something is thrashing; I hear it.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼，还带着腥味。
lines.en: The fish in your hand still smells of the sea.

lines.zh: 气泡一串串往上，是活物。
lines.en: Bubbles rise in strings; something lives there.
This scent is too fresh; I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 我看见影子在动，就过去了。
lines.en: I see a shadow move, and I go.
Do not wave your hand; that motion calls me.

lines.zh: 鱼群一散，说明有东西在。
lines.en: The fish scatter; something is there.
Come closer and let me see clearly.
Living things always run for the shallows.

lines.zh: 沉船边的骨头都是我的。
lines.en: The bones by the wreck are mine.

lines.zh: 把鱼骨再晃一晃给我看。
lines.en: Wave that fish bone at me again.

lines.zh: 小虫的味道，从沉船里来。
lines.en: Bug smell, coming from the wreck.

lines.zh: 沉船边的鱼，给我留一口。
lines.en: Leave me a bite of that wreck-side fish.
I smell a live little fish.
I watch that shadow. Is it a fish?
This fishy smell led me through the wreck.

lines.zh: 你撒的这点渣，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the scraps you scattered.

lines.zh: 那条鱼在我骨头上蹭来蹭去。
lines.en: That fish keeps rubbing against my bones.
A glowing fish — chasing it.
Bump me; these bones will not give way.
My skull knocked against the hull.
Move; do not block my path through water.
One touch and I turn on you.
Those ripples are yours; I remember them.
My tail bone caught you; count yourself lucky.
Do not press so close; you cloud the water.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边擦过去，故意。
lines.en: I graze past your leg on purpose.

lines.zh: 你退后，我就少一次冲撞。
lines.en: Step back, and I charge one time less.
The wreck is mine; stay away.

lines.zh: 没有鳞的身子，撞一下就响。
lines.en: A body without scales rattles at one bump.
Who bumped me till my bones clacked?

lines.zh: 我早没有鳞了，只剩骨头。
lines.en: I have no scales left, only bone.

lines.zh: 你比我的沉船龙骨还硬。
lines.en: You're harder than my wreck's keel.
Let me by. I'm wedged between planks.
My skull is very sharp.

lines.zh: 沉船边上，我的头骨当刀。
lines.en: By the wreck, my skull is the blade.
I nearly drifted away belly-up.
My bones are caught in a gap between planks.
This skeleton of mine is nearly falling apart.
A fish once patrolled this wreck with me.
Bone against bone will have to do.
You swim well, like my old companion.

lines.zh: 这片暗水里，只有我们俩。
lines.en: In this dark water there are only us two.

lines.zh: 别怕我的头骨，它不咬你。
lines.en: Do not fear my skull; it will not bite you.
Circle the wreck three times with me?
White bones in water carry no warmth.

lines.zh: 你留下来，我就不追海豚。
lines.en: Stay, and I will stop chasing dolphins.
A touch of tails will be our promise.

lines.zh: 沉船里还空着一个位置。
lines.en: There is still an empty place in the wreck.
One touch of bone blades seals it.
I laid bones in the wreck's corner.

lines.zh: 沉船附近，我一直在巡逻。
lines.en: I've been patrolling by this wreck all along.

lines.zh: 我们两条骨鱼并排巡船。
lines.en: Two bone fish, we patrol the wreck side by side.

lines.zh: 沉船的舱里，我想找个伴。
lines.en: In the wreck's hold, I want company.
I like the way your bones sway.

lines.zh: 沉船边上，我巡逻了一夜。
lines.en: I've patrolled by this wreck all night.

lines.zh: 我的头骨锯，磨得比刀还亮。
lines.en: My skull saw is polished brighter than a blade.

lines.zh: 沉船的骨架里，我们并排。
lines.en: Inside the wreck's ribs, we lie side by side.
I circle you, all bone.
This fish bone is mine.
Everything in the wreck belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我捡起一截断骨，塞进肋间。
lines.en: I pick up a broken bone and tuck it in my ribs.
This thing sinks; I nudge it along.

lines.zh: 海底的碎片，我一件件翻。
lines.en: I sift the debris on the seabed piece by piece.
A bone falls; I take it.
This hat sits strangely on my skull.

lines.zh: 箱子开了，里面的东西归我。
lines.en: The chest opened; its contents are mine.

lines.zh: 水中无主之物，碰见就算。
lines.en: Whatever lies ownerless in water, I claim.

lines.zh: 捡起来看看，不值钱就丢。
lines.en: I pick it up; worthless, so I drop it.
I'll bury it in the fine sand by the wreck.
This one's bright. I'll tuck it in my ribs.

lines.zh: 这顶汽水帽，也许能换鱼。
lines.en: This soda hat might trade for fish.

lines.zh: 我塞进沉船的肋骨缝里。
lines.en: I tuck it between the wreck's ribs.

lines.zh: 我再捡一件，骨头挂不住。
lines.en: One more and my bones can't hold it.

lines.zh: 我从船板底下摸出一块。
lines.en: I felt one out from under a plank.

lines.zh: 沉船边的骨头，都是我的。
lines.en: The bones by this wreck are mine.
What lies by the wreck is mine.
A fish of bone picks up only bone.
I watch something sink down from above.
That dolphin is mine to chase.
Something fell in the water; perfect.
I lock onto that trail of water.
It turned; I saw its eye.

lines.zh: 背上的骑手拍我，催快点。
lines.en: My rider pats my back, urging speed.
This fish is large; I am not afraid.
I drop low and charge from beneath.

lines.zh: 它往礁石里钻，我跟进去。
lines.en: It dives into the rocks; I follow.
Close enough; I am speeding up.
Whoever moves first loses.
That fish glinted. I'm after it.

lines.zh: 沉船的光里，我先看见它。
lines.en: In the wreck's glow, I saw it first.
My eye sockets are fixed on that fish.
This fish lasts me a day.

lines.zh: 沉船边，我的头骨磨得发亮。
lines.en: By the wreck my skull is worn bright.
I've waited by the wreck all night.

lines.zh: 我这把骨剑，从沉船边扫过。
lines.en: My bone blade sweeps past the wreck.
My skull clamps shut and stays shut.
Black water covers my shadow.
A sword grown from bone — charging.
I loop halfway and take its back.
It has not heard; my bones are light.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，头骨就够到。
lines.en: A little closer and my skull reaches.
The current pushes me; less effort.
It is panicking; its path is breaking.
Do not let it surface for air.
I hug the seabed, shadow hidden.

lines.zh: 它回头看了一次，没发现。
lines.en: It glanced back once and saw nothing.

lines.zh: 我的尾骨在摆，越快越稳。
lines.en: My tail swings faster and steadier.
Wait for it to turn; that is the gap.

lines.zh: 我一冲，骨头能把水切开。
lines.en: One dash and my skull splits the water.
Swim for the light; I still follow.
One more block closer is enough.
This bone fish doesn't turn back.
I patrol these wreck waters.
Your bubbles break before mine.
I patrol the dark water.

lines.zh: 我用头骨侧面划开水面。
lines.en: I cut the water with the side of my skull.
In black water, my bones give off a shine.

lines.zh: 哪块船板会响我都知道。
lines.en: I know which planks creak.
My skull sweeps sideways, splitting the water.
This thrust lands square in its flank.

lines.zh: 它挡了一下，骨头震得发麻。
lines.en: It blocked; my bones buzz from the shock.
Another thrust, too quick to follow.
I slam it against the ship's planks.
I bite and hold; my jaw grinds.
It strikes back; I twist aside.

lines.zh: 头骨卡住了，我甩头拔出来。
lines.en: My skull lodges; I wrench it free.
This blow drives it back into the dark.

lines.zh: 打完了，我绕船再巡一圈。
lines.en: Done; I circle the wreck once more.

lines.zh: 头骨像刀，从沉船边划过。
lines.en: My skull-blade cuts past the wreck.
A bone fish can still charge.

lines.zh: 你游得快，我这具骨架更快。
lines.en: You swim fast, but this skeleton is faster.
Back off. My skull saw is coming.

lines.zh: 我的头骨，就是最利的剑。
lines.en: My skull is the sharpest blade around.
In this charge my bone blade arrives first.
Don't struggle between my skull jaws.
My skull saws across.

lines.zh: 我的头骨切过去，像划水。
lines.en: My skull blade cuts through like a paddle stroke.
My skull works as a blade.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的阴影里游出来。
lines.en: I swim out of the wreck's shadow.
The dark water stirs; I have arrived.

lines.zh: 骨头在水里慢慢沉下来。
lines.en: Bones settle slowly through the water.
This sunken ship is mine from now on.
The mast leans; perfect to hide behind.

lines.zh: 我听见上面有人在划水。
lines.en: I hear someone paddling above.
First lap: learn the terrain.
Seaweed parts; I am here.

lines.zh: 头骨先探出，后面才是我。
lines.en: My skull emerges first, then the rest.

lines.zh: 这片水域的味道，我记下了。
lines.en: I have memorized the taste of these waters.
This dark current pushed me out.
I circle this empty wreck.
I smell rust in this water.

lines.zh: 我沉在暗水里，等你游近。
lines.en: I sink in dark water and wait for you to near.
I know these shipwreck waters.

lines.zh: 沉船的暗处，我游出来了。
lines.en: Out of the wreck's dark, I swim.

lines.zh: 我骨头缝里还挂着水草。
lines.en: Weeds still cling between my bones.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的影子里钻出来。
lines.en: I slide out of the shipwreck's shadow.

lines.zh: 沉船的舱底，只有我的骨头在响。
lines.en: In the wreck's hold, only my bones rattle.
Did I swim back here myself?

lines.zh: 骨头被烧得发黑，我下沉。
lines.en: Flame blackens my bones; I sink.
The water boils, and my bones burn.

lines.zh: 从水面砸下去，骨头散了一下。
lines.en: I crash down; my bones rattle apart a moment.

lines.zh: 我这副骨架，被沙粒磨得响。
lines.en: Sand grinds against my bare bones.

lines.zh: 水涌进肋骨，我不需要呼吸。
lines.en: Water floods my ribs; I need no breath.
Fish I may be, but I'm nearly drowning.

lines.zh: 气浪把我冲散，又拼回去。
lines.en: The blast scatters me, and I pull myself together.
The blast rattles every bone in me.
The arrow went through my gill bone.

lines.zh: 头骨裂了，剑还举得起来。
lines.en: My skull cracked, but the blade still lifts.
Light scorches my bones; it stings.
The purple light makes my bones itch.
Hunger? I forgot what that was long ago.
I can't even crunch a fish bone.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水打过来，我麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning runs through the water; I go numb.
Lightning runs through the black water to me.

lines.zh: 骨头沉下去，没有水接住。
lines.en: My bones sink, and no water catches them.
I can't find the black water below.
